beforeYouStart: Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, and there is no mission replay — PowerPyx recommends 10 chapter saves and rotating the other 5.
Do the one thing that can be missed early: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason’s house (see Positive Mental Attitude). Everything else can wait.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you meet them. The WAiNK app and the binoculars are unlocked in Chapter 1, and the counts you build now already feed the 100% checklist.
estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough — PowerPyx
intro: Every step below is built from the official trophy descriptions and the published roadmap by PowerPyx (18–19 Nov 2026). There are no difficulty settings, no mission gold medals, no mission replay and no New Game+, but there is free-roam after the story — so nothing below needs a second playthrough. Keep cheats off: using one disables trophies and saving.

missables.body: PowerPyx and GTA Zone both flag exactly one trophy as potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude. The first meditation is offered at Jason’s house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter. Nobody has confirmed whether the trophy actually needs it — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so the safe move is to do it. Everything else, story trophies included, cannot be missed: all trophy-related quest givers are still available after the story in free-roam, and nothing on the 100% checklist is missable. A few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that later close, but they also spawn elsewhere and are not needed for any trophy.
missables.headline: Potentially 1 missable trophy — and it is only a maybe
safeList: All 13 story trophies (chapters, missions, final mission) — automatic, unmissable.
All six character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) — still open after the story.
All 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — still there in free-roam.
Everything on the 100% checklist — nothing on it is missable.
Optional missions that disappear after a while — they do not matter for trophies, because there are far more than the 100 the checklist asks for.

stages.body: Finish the story and enjoy it. The 100% checklist is not viewable until after the story, but any progress you make during it already counts. There are no mission gold medals to chase, so you do not need to watch for hidden objectives. Take optional missions as they appear — purple icons and black icons with pink letters — because the 100% checklist later asks for any 100 of them, and there are far more than 100 in the game. Work through the character questlines as they open: Andy (Lucia, Chapter 3), Kenton (Chapter 1), Billy (Chapter 2), Randy (Chapter 3), Tyrone (Jason, Chapter 3) and Bret (Jason, after Chapter 2). The single warning of this stage is the Chapter 1 meditation — see Missables.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–5

stages.body: After the credits you are returned to the open world and the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of the 255 animals studied, 300 of the 397 stunts, all 42 Shooting Range golds, all 42 Top Fun drone races, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and all 15 of Bret’s Target Decks, plus partial collectibles. Nothing on it is missable. This stage is where A Long Road (gold) lands, and with it most of the silver trophies.
stages.title: The 100% Completion checklist

stages.body: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so finish the 8 counting strands here (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed), then sweep up whatever is left: the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the combat and robbery trophies, the money trophies, and the five trophies whose exact triggers no guide has confirmed yet (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin). The platinum pops when the last one does.
